graph.data: ['R. Michalski, S. Palus, and P. Kazienko, "Matching organizational structure and social network extracted from email communication." In Lecture Notes in Business Information Processing 87, 197-206 (2011), http://www.ii.pwr.edu.pl/~michalski/publications/pub_2011_bis.pdf']

A network of emails among employee email addresses at a mid-sized manufacturing company. Each directed edge represents an email sent from address i to address j. Edges are timestamped, and occurred over a 6 month period in an unspecified year.

category: Communication code: RA name: Manufacturing emails description: Employee–employee email entity-names: employee extr: radoslaw url: http://www.ii.pwr.wroc.pl/~michalski/index.php?content=datasets#manufacturing long-description: This is the internal email communication network between employees of a mid-sized manufacturing company. The network is directed and nodes represent employees. The left node represents the sender and the right node represents the recipient.
